clarifications_added_during_review: A pixel centre just outside the image can remain eligible when its bilinear footprint overlaps the image; evidence is normalized by positive coverage.
The target describes the difference at the requested horizon, not any earlier divergence. Raw and pooled targets can legitimately differ for a transient change.
limitations_and_items_before_execution: This review concerns bounded source behavior and synthetic gradients only. It does not authorize an emulator, collection, training, performance benchmark or gate, and establishes no perception/control skill.

The target function cannot certify that two pixel arrays came from one paid branch pair, a common archived anchor, the correct effect, authorized agent data or the requested prediction horizon. The future collector must bind these facts prospectively and retain actual branch lengths and failures.

The learning module uses the existing RGB trace type and difference helper, which transitively import the frozen environment base definitions. This review checks the pure data path only; no engine construction or private state access occurs.

Controllability is a hypothesis from branch pixel differences at an own predicted position. Other objects, indirect consequences, faulty motion, pooling and sticky action delays can create or hide evidence; there is no ME decision or causal isolation guarantee.

A complete unchanged endpoint is a negative target only for that effect, projected support, image kind and horizon. It does not establish absence of control at another delay or elsewhere in the trajectory.

Partial coverage is renormalized and then given unit supervision weight, even when the visible fraction is small. Targets average equally over projected source pixels and are broadcast per component; projection collisions and segmentation errors are not resolved into true physical causes.

The actual track capacity, image dimensions, observation interval, target horizon, motion threshold, raw/pooled choice and training weights remain to be fixed in a prospective collection/training protocol.

The default4MiB bound applies only to the main assignment cost matrix. Full RSS and copy time remain unmeasured; input materialization, other matrices, histories and up to twice-capacity temporary candidate tracks remain additional costs. Maximum allowed4096 capacity yields a256MiB main matrix, not4MiB.

A post-assignment refusal has performed synthetic tracker computation but commits no tracking state. In future live wiring, already paid image/branch work must still be recorded even when learning-side capacity rejects the update.

Group and identity objectives, the collector and any integrated learner are separate new modules outside this receipt. No previous raw/temporal calibration or CPU result is reinterpreted as learner validation.
